description: This file contains shell script code that performs automated testing of Git push operations under various conditions, including normal pushes, atomic pushes, forced updates, and non-fast-forward pushes. It uses shell commands to execute Git operations, compare outputs, and verify refs states.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Sets up a test scenario expecting success, executes shell commands, and verifies output against expected results.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail, capturing its output for verification.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual output to expected output for correctness.

methods.name: test_cmp_refs
methods.description: Compares Git refs between local and remote repositories.

methods.name: format_and_save_expect
methods.description: Formats and saves expected output snippets for comparison.

methods.name: filter_out_user_friendly_and_stable_output
methods.description: Filters command output to remove non-essential or unstable parts for consistent testing.
